model.description: Input LS-DYNA K-file (or use 'input' as alternative key name). *INCLUDE files are followed for reference counting.

output.description: Output K-file. Only written when mode is safe or force; defaults to the input name with a '_clean' suffix.

mode.description: report (default) classifies and writes no deck. safe deletes only nodes no understood or unknown keyword could name, and refuses when an *INCLUDE could not be read. force additionally deletes nodes that only an unmodelled keyword named, and counts them in force_deleted_despite_unknown.

prune_sets.description: Remove deleted nodes from *SET_NODE / *SET_NODE_LIST / *SET_NODE_COLUMN member lists. Turning this off leaves set members pointing at nodes that no longer exist, which the read-back verification then reports as a failure.

verify.description: Read the written deck back and confirm every element node reference and every node set member is defined. Non-zero exit if not.

keep_referenced_by.description: Keyword prefixes (without the leading '*') whose node references are attributed by name in the report and honoured even in mode: force. Keywords left out of this list are still scanned and still keep their nodes — they are just reported as unknown_keyword_kept.

report.description: Write the classification as JSON: node counts, kept_by per keyword, unknown_keyword_kept, sets_pruned, verify, and bbox_before/bbox_after.

extra_inputs.description: 옵션이 가리키는 보조 파일의 절대경로. 잡 work/ 폴더로 같이 올라가므로 옵션 값에는 파일 이름만 쓰면 된다. 허용 범위: /data/single/<사용자>/, /shared/uploads/users/<사용자>/, /data/scenario/.

slurm.description: 잡 자원(선택). 생략하면 도구 종류별 기본(전처리 2 CPU·8G, 후처리 4 CPU·16G, 24시간)을 클러스터에서 가장 큰 노드에 맞춰 줄여 쓴다.

dry_run.description: true 면 제출하지 않고 생성될 입력 파일·명령만 돌려준다(PAT 없이도 된다). 먼저 이걸로 확인할 것.

wait_sec.description: 제출 후 이 시간(초) 안에 끝나면 결과(rc·로그 꼬리·작은 산출물)를 함께 돌려준다. 0 = job_id 만.

job_name.description: 잡 이름(결과 폴더 이름이 된다). 생략하면 stmc_<도구이름>.
